Leo (Data): Hey folks — first day trying to spin up a Codespace for `redwood-inference/notebooks` and I get:
```
Couldn’t find repository or you don’t have access.
Error: Access denied (SAML) or repo not visible.
```
I accepted the org invite but GitHub shows two accounts for me (leo+work and my personal leo@gmail). Not sure which account the invite landed on. Who do I ping to fix access?
Priya (Platform): @Leo can you paste `gh auth status` output and confirm which email is listed as primary in https://github.com/settings/emails ? If the invite went to your work alias you need that alias verified on the GH account you use.
Leo (Data): `gh auth status` shows: you are logged into GitHub.com as leo (leo@gmail.com)
I checked emails — leo+work@company.com is listed but not primary. The invite email from People Ops was to leo+work@company.com.
Nora (People Ops): We sent the invite to the company address you provided. Looks like acceptance landed on your personal account instead. We can resend but easier if you make the company email the primary on your GH account and verify it.
James (Security): FYI org policy enforces SAML SSO + 2FA and requires a verified company email for automatic team mapping. If your primary is personal GH account, SSO mapping won't attach org roles. Steps: add and verify work email, set it as primary, then re-accept SSO for the org (https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/account_authorizations/new).
Leo (Data): I made leo+work primary and verified. Re-authorized SSO for redwood-inference — still seeing the same Codespaces error.
Priya (Platform): Try logging out of the CLI and browser session: `gh auth logout` then `gh auth login` and then retry Codespaces. Also check https://github.com/organizations/redwood-inference/saml/sso to authorize the app.
Leo (Data): Did `gh auth logout` / login, authorized SSO link — still blocked with "SAML access required" when creating a Codespace from repo page.
James (Security): I pulled the org audit logs — invite went to leo+work but People Ops accidentally approved membership for leo@gmail entry earlier, creating duplicate accounts in our system. I consolidated memberships and forced reprovision for your account, plus I temporarily added you to team `dev-data` so Codespaces can provision.
codespaces-bot: note: codespace request queued for leo — provisioning cluster allocation...
codespaces-bot: success: Codespace created for leo at redwood-inference/notebooks (branch: main) — id cs-12345.
Leo (Data): It worked! I can open the Codespace and see the repo. Thanks @James and @Priya.
Nora (People Ops): Thanks for the heads up — we'll update the new-hire checklist to call out: 1) ensure company email is primary and verified, 2) explicitly authorize org SSO, 3) wait ~30s for team mapping. I'll add a note about alias addresses (leo+work) confusing the flow.
Leo (Data): Appreciate it. Leaving this thread in case future new hires hit the same alias/duplicate-account snag. :thumbsup:
